title: Couriers
subtitle: The delivery companies you book parcels with: their rates, rules and switches.

common.loadFailed: We could not load this. Check your connection and try again.

list.title: Couriers
list.readOnly: You can look at the couriers but not change them.
list.emptyHint: Add a courier to start booking parcels.

card.rateValue: {base} up to {grams}, then {extra} per extra kg
card.notConnectedHint: This courier has no account yet, so it cannot be switched on. Real courier accounts are connected later with your own keys.

archive.title: Archive {name}?
archive.description: It will no longer be offered when booking parcels. Parcels already with this courier stop you from archiving it.

connections.title: Courier connections
connections.note: Only the sandbox courier works today: it is a practice courier that you move along by hand. The other couriers are ready slots. They are connected, one by one, when you have an account with that company and hand over its keys. Keys are never typed into these screens or stored in the database.
connections.simulatorText: A practice courier for testing the whole parcel journey. Staff with the right permission move its parcels along by hand.
connections.configuredText: This connection has its account keys and can take parcels.
connections.slotText: A slot for this courier. It cannot be switched on or take parcels until its account is connected.
connections.couriersUsing: {count, plural, one {# courier uses it} other {# couriers use it}}

form.description: Rates here are what the courier charges the shop and rank the suggestions. What the customer pays is set by the delivery zones, unless you set a flat charge below.
form.codeHint: 2 to 30 letters, digits, - or _. It cannot be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.providerHint: The adapter that talks to the courier.
form.priorityHint: 1 to 1000. The lowest number is offered first.
form.enabledBlocked: This connection is not set up, so the courier cannot be switched on.
form.zonesHint: Tick none to serve every zone.
form.zonesTypedHint: The zone list is not available to you. Type codes separated by commas, or leave empty for every zone.
form.pricesHint: The rates are what the courier charges the shop. The flat charge changes what the customer pays.
form.chargeOverrideHint: Optional. Replaces the zone's base and weight fees for domestic orders. Remote surcharge and free delivery still apply.
form.trackingTemplateHint: Optional. Must start with https:// and contain '{consignment}', which is replaced by the parcel number.
form.settingsWarning: Only plain details such as a store id or area code. Keys, tokens and passwords are never stored by these screens; the system refuses a setting whose name looks like a secret.

errors.code: Use 2 to 30 capital letters, digits, - or _.
errors.name: Write a name (up to 100 characters).
errors.priority: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.weight: Enter a whole number of grams.
errors.weightRange: The heaviest weight cannot be below the lightest.
errors.money: Enter an amount with at most two decimals.
errors.tracking: Use an https:// address that contains '{consignment}'.
errors.secret: A setting name looks like a key or password. Those are never stored here.
errors.duplicate: Two settings have the same name.
